title: Pachinko
author: Min Jin Lee
description: A novel that follows four generations of a Korean family as they make a life in Japan.
reflection: What stayed with me was how trauma carries across generations.

title: Everything I Never Told You
author: Celeste Ng
description: After their teenage daughter is found dead, a Chinese American family in 1970s Ohio begins to reckon with what they never knew about her or one another.
reflection: Seeing an Asian family in the Midwest felt familiar to me.

title: Chemistry
author: Weike Wang
description: A chemistry graduate student starts questioning the future she’s been working toward, both in the lab and outside it.
reflection: I loved how funny the narrator was.

title: The Opposite of Loneliness
author: Marina Keegan
description: A posthumous collection of Marina Keegan’s essays and short fiction, including her reflection on the sense of belonging she found at Yale.
reflection: The wanting to belong is what stayed with me.
